sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner  submits that the petitioner is aggrieved by  the impugned proceedings dated  26.06.2023 (wrongly typed as 2023; it  ought to be 26.06.2025).
It is submitted that  the 4th respondent has issued a show cause notice to the petitioner on 26.06.2025, and a reply was submitted on 27.06.2025.

However,
the 2nd respondent has issued the impugned proceedings unmindful of the show cause notice issued by the 4th respondent and the reply submitted by the petitioner.

It is also submitted that the petitioner has obtained a registration certificate under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, and the State Government has issued the relevant certificate for conducting business relating to milk and dairy products.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The learned Standing Counsel appearing for the 2nd respondent requested time to file a counter.

Contd..
 SL. OFFICE No. DATE ORDER NOTE

Be that as it may, considering the submissions that the impugned proceedings were issued by the 2nd respondent unmindful of the show cause notice issued by the 4th respondent on 26.06.2025 and the reply submitted by the petitioner on 27.06.2025, the impugned proceedings could not have been issued.
Accordingly, the impugned proceedings shall stand suspended.
